arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import os
total=0; entries=0
for base, dirs, files in os.walk('submission'):
    for name in dirs+files:
        entries+=1
        p=os.path.join(base,name)
        st=os.lstat(p)
        if os.path.isfile(p): total+=st.st_size
print('entries', entries, 'bytes', total)
" && TMPDIR=/workspace/tmp python3 tmp/harness/public_check_local.py submission && ls -la submission submission/crosscheck
